name: dev-discipline
description: Evidence-driven development discipline for coding agents, starting with strict RED-GREEN-REFACTOR TDD.

interface.longDescription: Dev Discipline controls coding-agent implementation order with auditable workflows. Its first skill enforces strict RED-GREEN-REFACTOR TDD, regression tests for bug fixes, minimal GREEN changes, and honest command evidence.
defaultPrompt: TDD로 구현해줘. RED 실패부터 실제로 확인해.
이 버그를 회귀 테스트부터 작성해서 고쳐줘.
strict RED-GREEN-REFACTOR로 진행하고 명령 증거를 남겨줘.
